Hudsonus, God of the Hudson Bay drainage basin - A rugged and resilient god, ruling over the vast wilderness of the Hudson Bay drainage basin. He is associated with the frozen landscapes, boreal forests, and mighty rivers of the region. He is revered as a hunter, protector, and guide, and is known for his stoic and unwavering demeanor.
